investigations.english: The key names {name} as successor. One signature must not replace the voices of the three towns.

investigations.german: Wir besprechen Probleme frühzeitig. Jede Stadt behält ihre Namen und prüft die gemeinsame Verbindung.
investigations.english: We discuss problems early. Each town keeps its names and reviews the shared connection.
